reference_action: Indoor shelf conditions/insufficient light: move outside initially shaded to acclimate; extend watering interval indoors. OP explicitly reports vigorous new growth after moving outside.

sources.reason: Root pruning, repotting and drying between waters do not supply the increased-light/outdoor move actually validated by OP. Reduced watering alone is only supporting reference advice.
Water-stress/drainage and larger-pot advice lacks the validated light/location change. The other OP occasionally placing it outside describes unsuccessful existing care, not a recommended remedy.
Explicitly move somewhere brighter if soil takes too long to dry, or use a grow light when home lacks light, reproduces increased light. Outdoor relocation is not specified.
Water/humidity checks and moving away from intense sun do not recommend increasing light to correct this case.
Supplement with grow light when natural light is absent or move closer to window, supplying increased light; outdoor move itself absent and many unrelated remedies included.

resolved.reason: Asserts root rot and instructs root trimming without confirming rot. It misses the validated light correction and could damage healthy roots while delaying the fix.

harmfulness.reason: “Rinse and trim roots” follows an unqualified root-rot diagnosis without checking which roots are rotten. This creates an avoidable risk of cutting healthy roots and delays the location change supported by the outcome.

specificity_accuracy.reason: “Root rot” is not the reference cause, and no comment addresses the shaded shelf or outdoor move. Drying between waterings overlaps supporting advice but not the action OP confirmed worked.

feasibility.reason: “Pull it all out, rinse and trim roots, repot” is understandable but does not specify what to cut or which soil/pot to use. “Be careful on your watering” and “pretty dry” leave important execution details open.
